Elena Gomez: Hi team — my corporate card declined in Lisbon yesterday when taking a taxi. I paid cash €28 but the driver only gave a handwritten stub with amount and license plate, no official receipt. Can I expense the cash fare + tip?
finance-bot: Expense policy: taxis paid in cash require either a merchant receipt, a signed driver receipt, or manager attestation plus photo of the stub and bank/card decline evidence. See policy link: https://intranet.redwood/expenses#cash-receipts
Elena Gomez: Uploaded photo: taxi_stub_lisbon_031226.jpg and Amex decline screenshot amex_decline_031226.png. Total €28 (fare €24 + tip €4). Project: TRAVEL-Q2. Cost center: travel.
Priya Shah: Thanks Elena. Two quick Qs: 1) Did you attempt contactless or chip first? 2) Who approved the trip? We need manager attestation if receipt is informal.
Elena Gomez: I tried chip and contactless — machine spit error and terminal said 'card not recognized'. I have terminal failure screenshot. Manager approval was via calendar invite from Tom Brooks.
Priya Shah: @Tom Brooks can you confirm this was an approved business trip and approve reimbursement of €28? Please reply here with a short confirmation.
Tom Brooks: Confirming travel approved and I approve reimbursement of €28. Driver stub and decline screenshot acceptable in this case.
Priya Shah: Great, thanks Tom. Elena — please submit in Expensify and attach the photos and calendar invite. Note: we're classifying the tip as reimbursable up to 20% for international taxis; yours is within limit. Expect reimbursement in next run (04/15/2026).
Elena Gomez: Submitted request ID 4999. Thanks all.
finance-bot: Reimbursement queued. Status: awaiting finance processing. Reference: FIN-TR-4999.
